description: Config-driven prior authorization workflow that maps payer criteria to patient evidence and creates a human-review packet.

subagents.name: Healthcare Document Intake Agent
subagents.input_summary: Classify patient document and extract patient/encounter context before prior authorization review.

subagents.name: Prior Authorization Request Agent
subagents.input_summary: Extract requested service, diagnosis, clinical rationale, and urgency from patient documents.

subagents.name: Payer Policy Criteria Agent
subagents.input_summary: Extract payer medical necessity criteria and required documentation from policy guide documents.

subagents.name: Evidence Mapping Agent
subagents.input_summary: Map each payer criterion to patient evidence with citations and status.

subagents.name: Gap Detection Agent
subagents.input_summary: Identify missing documents, incomplete fields, and denial/submission risks.

subagents.name: Prior Authorization Packet Agent
subagents.input_summary: Create a human-review prior authorization packet with checklist, narrative, and next actions.
